methodology.primary: original manual primary and background control choices only; independent pockets and research model_entries excluded
methodology.deduplication: earliest original decision per event before outcomes; unpriced first decisions never replaced
methodology.maturity: entry at least3h before latest saved snapshot; unconfirmed outcomes remain unknown
methodology.outcome_timing: strict models train only on matching confirmed results recorded before next test-day midnight; older confirmations missing are not fabricated
methodology.features: as-of original source snapshot, with explicit legacy fallbacks; absence never becomes zero
methodology.validation: time-ordered historical diagnostic, predeclared feature families and ridge20; not an untouched prospective trial
methodology.multiplicity: approximate BH across fixed univariate comparisons; causal interpretation prohibited
methodology.missing_scope: archive begins13October, no invented earlier weeks; unpublished human judgment and uncollected outside-pool detail cannot be recovered
